name: Can you install new shower tile directly over existing tile?

mainEntity.name: Can you install new shower tile directly over existing tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laying new tile directly over old shower tile is not recommended and should almost always be avoided. Shower enclosures must be completely watertight, and installing over existing tile conceals underlying moisture issues, framing rot, or failed waterproofing. The added thickness can also interfere with shower fixtures, valve stems, and door seals, while thin-set mortar struggles to achieve a permanent bond over glazed ceramic surfaces. Removing the old tile down to the wall studs allows installers to inspect the framing, correct plumbing, and install a modern, continuous waterproofing system that guarantees long-term protection.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, tiling over existing shower tile is not recommended. Demolishing old tile ensures studs are sound and allows for a fresh, reliable waterproofing system.
